label: rem:dictionary-flavor-layer
title: The knot--particle--force dictionary: flavor supplement
html:
The knot--particle dictionary of the knots-particles chapter maps each particle to a specific braid configuration: leptons to torus knots T(2, 2k+1), bosons to torus links T(2, 2k), quarks to unknot strands in the Borromean braid, and composite hadrons to products under \bowtie_K. This chapter adds the flavor layer: each dictionary entry now carries the A_2 quantum numbers (I_3, Y) from the hexagonal weight lattice.

[Table]
LaTeX source
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{l l c c l}
\hline
Particle & Braid & $I_3$ & $Y$ & Status \\
\hline
\multicolumn{5}{c}{\textit{Quarks (unknot strands in Borromean braid)}} \\
$u$ & $\sigma_i^{+1}$ strand & $+\tfrac{1}{2}$ & $+\tfrac{1}{3}$ & conditional on $N=3$ \\
$d$ & $\sigma_i^{-1}$ strand & $-\tfrac{1}{2}$ & $+\tfrac{1}{3}$ & conditional on $N=3$ \\
$s$ & $\sigma_j^{-1}$ (2nd gen) & $0$ & $-\tfrac{2}{3}$ & conditional on $N=3$ \\
\hline
\multicolumn{5}{c}{\textit{Mesons ($q\bar{q}$ via $\bowtie_K$)}} \\
$\pi^+$ & $u \bowtie_K \bar{d}$ & $+1$ & $0$ & octet (\Ssec:meson-octet) \\
$K^+$   & $u \bowtie_K \bar{s}$ & $+\tfrac{1}{2}$ & $+1$ & octet \\
$\eta$   & $(u\bar{u}+d\bar{d}-2s\bar{s})/\sqrt{6}$ & $0$ & $0$ & octet \\
$\eta'$  & $(u\bar{u}+d\bar{d}+s\bar{s})/\sqrt{3}$ & $0$ & $0$ & singlet \\
\hline
\multicolumn{5}{c}{\textit{Baryons ($qqq$ via Borromean $\bowtie_K$)}} \\
$p$ & Borromean $(uud)$ & $+\tfrac{1}{2}$ & $+1$ & octet (\Ssec:baryon-multiplets) \\
$n$ & Borromean $(udd)$ & $-\tfrac{1}{2}$ & $+1$ & octet \\
$\Delta^{++}$ & symmetric $(uuu)$ & $+\tfrac{3}{2}$ & $+1$ & decuplet \\
$\Omega^-$    & symmetric $(sss)$ & $0$ & $-2$ & decuplet \\
\hline
\multicolumn{5}{c}{\textit{Color charge (orthogonal to flavor)}} \\
$r, g, b$ & $G_2$ stabilizer (\Ssec:color-algebra) & --- & --- & not excluded by the Sym$^2$ gate \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

Epistemic tiers. The isospin I_3 column is derived (writhe-to-isospin map, no fitted parameters). The hypercharge Y column is open (candidate: ribbon twist; battery: Gell-Mann--Nishijima consistency). The quark flavor assignments are conditional on N = 3 (the central open problem of this chapter). The color assignments follow from the octonionic G_2 route but remain at the discrete-skeleton level pending the continuous G_2 completion.

What the (I_3, Y) columns are. With one exception they are the standard \mathrm{SU}(3)_{\mathrm{f}} flavour assignments, imported from the eightfold-way classification and placed against the braid column to show that the dictionary is consistent with it. They are not outputs of the braid construction. The exception is I_3 on the nucleon doublet, where the writhe difference reproduces \Delta I_3 = 1 scale-free --- that entry is derived. Every Y entry, and every quark row, is either open or conditional on N = 3.

No entry in this table is a fit --- nothing here was tuned to match data --- but neither is the table a derivation of the flavour quantum numbers. It is a consistency ledger, and will be updated as the open problems of the open-problems section are resolved.
